pr_title: Add border showing selected blueprints in timeline
pr_body:
Closes #12425.

Bit of a temporary design for now. Also adds in the always-present borders from flyte's new design logic.

![20210416 181908 (dotnet)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/115002962-44db0780-9ee0-11eb-804a-d3f7b40139f2.gif)

Edge case where combo colour is a similar yellow:

![20210416 182245 (dotnet)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/115003444-c3d04000-9ee0-11eb-913d-a45180740ecd.png)

It's not perfect, but as the objects are also lightened in colour you can still see the difference.

issue_context.title: New editor timeline hit objects don't display selections
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 

It's very difficult to tell which hitobjects are selected with the new blueprints in the editor timeline.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1329837/114863684-020b2800-9e2b-11eb-98a4-32402acb8878.png)
comments: Yeah, I'm aware of this. Will add back tomorrow in some form I guess. Luckily selections are generally consecutive so it's not a common issue.

review_comments: Had to remove the edge effect applied below, else it shows up in the empty space and makes everything dark. I can split out the base class if you think it's worth it, and only apply the `EdgeEffect` in the other implementation.
Ah, I somehow missed that there was an edge effect there in my original review :open_mouth:
